text:
emily (eng): hey @people-ops — quick help please. My spouse had an ER visit on 2026-07-04 and the claim came back denied because carrier couldn't locate member. Claim# 55660077. We're on Family Premier and my spouse is listed as Anna Garcia-Lopez on our enrollment, but the hospital billed her as Anna Lopez. Member last4 on our docs is 3321. Any guidance?

rachel (People Ops): sorry that happened. can you DM a photo of the EOB and the hospital bill (they usually print the name they billed under)? also when did you submit the marriage certificate / dependent add?
emily (eng): I uploaded the marriage cert and dependent add form in the benefits portal on 2026-06-01. The benefits summary in the portal now shows spouse as "Anna Garcia Lopez" (no hyphen). The hospital bill shows "Anna Lopez" (no Garcia). EOB says "patient not found / member not active" and allowed $0.

marc (Benefits): two likely issues: 1) provider entered the billed name differently and clearinghouse couldn't match to subscriber/dependent index, or 2) the carrier's member index didn't update yet (some nightly feeds). We can: a) ask provider to resubmit using subscriber ID and dependent relationship code, b) ask carrier to do a member-matching override for the service date, or c) if enrollment effective date is after service date, request retro coverage. Which effective date is showing in portal?
emily (eng): portal shows spouse effective 2026-06-01, so before the 07-04 visit.
han (Health Plan Liaison): I'll open a carrier inquiry. Recommended provider resubmit payload we use (send to hospital billing): ```service_date: 2026-07-04
claim_id: 55660077
patient_name_submitted: Anna Lopez
patient_name_correct: Anna Garcia-Lopez
subscriber_name: Emily Santos
subscriber_member_id: XXXXXX3321
patient_relationship: spouse
patient_dob: 1989-05-12
notes: please resubmit using subscriber/member ID and include dependent relationship code to enable correct matching.```I'll request the carrier to perform member index correction for service date and reprocess.
rachel (People Ops): @emily we'll also need a signed HIPAA release to allow us to speak with the carrier and the hospital on Anna's behalf. Please DM the signed release or upload here: https://benefits.example.com/claims-portal.
emily (eng): got it  I'll upload the EOB, hospital bill, and the signed release now. thanks.
han (Health Plan Liaison): opened carrier case REF-MATCH-2026-920. Requested member index review for 2026-07-04 and asked for expedited re-adjudication if matching error found. I'll CC hospital billing if they provide a contact. Carrier SLA ~ 7-10 business days.

hr-bot: Enrollment & name-change checklist: https://benefits.example.com/name-change-guide  if names vary (hyphenation / middle name), suggest uploading marriage cert + spouse ID and confirming member ID with provider at check-in to avoid re-billing.
rachel (People Ops): thanks @han. once carrier responds we'll update here and let you know if Redwood can assist with an advance while appeal is pending. :white_check_mark:
